user.title: Crafty Controller
user.description: Enter the address of your Crafty Controller and an API token created in your Crafty user settings.

data_description.verify_ssl: Keep this on when Crafty has a certificate Home Assistant trusts. Turn it off only for Crafty's default self-signed certificate: the connection is still encrypted, but Home Assistant can't tell it's really talking to your Crafty, so the API token could be sent to an impostor on your network.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Crafty Controller
reconfigure.description: Change the address of your Crafty Controller or the certificate check. The API token stays the same.

reauth_confirm.title: New Crafty API token
reauth_confirm.description: Crafty at {url} rejected the API token. Create a new API token in your Crafty user settings and enter it here.
